economic_hypothesis: When short-horizon movement hazard is predictable but direction is not, a symmetric pair of conditional market entries may monetize the realized direction. The edge exists only if post-trigger continuation exceeds observed spread, market-order cost, non-atomic cancel latency and double-trigger whipsaw losses.
objective_boundary: The final project target remains at least 1% realistic after-cost calendar-day geometric NAV growth. This public-sample fatal-edge study reports growth per observed sample day and is not eligible for the overall strategy ranking without full-day coverage and independent source reconstruction.

data.third_party_boundary: A positive result is exploratory until reconstructed from official Binance data or an independent second source.

event_clock.decision_information: Only events with local_timestamp strictly before the decision timestamp are usable.
event_clock.day_boundary: No feature, label, pending order or open position may cross a UTC sample-day boundary.

hazard_label.reference: last fresh midpoint strictly before the decision timestamp
hazard_label.definition: 1 if the maximum absolute fresh midpoint move from the reference during [decision+100ms, decision+30s] is at least 15bp; otherwise 0.
hazard_label.overlap_note: Overlapping fit labels are permitted for model estimation but are not counted as independent strategy trades.

feature_boundary: Every rolling feature ends at the last 100ms bin strictly before the decision. Missing or stale values remain unavailable; no forward fill across freshness limits, interpolation or future normalization is allowed.

models.name: logistic
models.pipeline: median imputation fitted on fit days, StandardScaler fitted on fit days, LogisticRegression C=0.1 class_weight=balanced max_iter=1000 random_state=20260726

models.name: hgbt
models.pipeline: median imputation fitted on fit days, HistGradientBoostingClassifier max_depth=2 learning_rate=0.05 max_iter=120 l2_regularization=1.0 min_samples_leaf=100 random_state=20260726 with fit-label inverse-frequency sample weights

score_thresholds.fit_rule: Each model's thresholds are fixed from its score distribution on fit-day decision rows before any development PnL is computed.

synthetic_entry_pair.order_type_semantics: Two independent equal-quantity contract-price stop-market-style orders. No exchange-atomic OCO behavior is assumed.
synthetic_entry_pair.upper_trigger: last fresh ask before decision multiplied by 1 + entry_offset_bp/10000
synthetic_entry_pair.lower_trigger: last fresh bid before decision multiplied by 1 - entry_offset_bp/10000
synthetic_entry_pair.trigger: first 100ms bin after activation whose observed trade maximum reaches the upper trigger or observed trade minimum reaches the lower trigger
synthetic_entry_pair.market_fill: first fresh ask for a buy or fresh bid for a sell at or after trigger plus latency; no favorable price improvement is assumed
synthetic_entry_pair.double_trigger: After the first fill, the opposite entry remains active until first-fill time plus cancel latency. If its trigger occurs before cancellation becomes effective, the equal opposite market fill flattens the position and ends the trade. Same-bin triggers are treated as a double-trigger round trip.
synthetic_entry_pair.global_slot: The account has one pending pair or one open position at a time. The slot releases after pending expiry, double-trigger flattening or final position exit.

position_exit.target_and_stop: Reduce-only contract-price market triggers measured from the actual entry fill.
position_exit.gap_execution: first fresh observed bid for a long exit or ask for a short exit after trigger plus latency, even when worse than the trigger
position_exit.time_exit: first fresh executable BBO after entry plus maximum_life_seconds plus 100ms
position_exit.post_exit_opposite_order: reduce-only; it cannot open a reverse position after the position is flat

candidate_grid.candidate_id: first 20 hexadecimal characters of SHA-256 over canonical sorted candidate JSON

account_and_cost.participation_cap: 0.1% of observed prior three-second traded quote volume
account_and_cost.cost_application: A normal target, stop, timeout or double-trigger path has two market fills and pays one registered round-trip cost. Identical market paths are replayed under every cost and cancel-latency profile.
account_and_cost.sizing_cost_reserve: Use the selected cost profile plus stop distance in planned-loss sizing; baseline account path is 12bp and separate 18/24bp paths are replayed from identical signals.

freeze_and_selection.freeze: If development survivors exist, freeze the single highest 18bp observed-day geometric-growth candidate per model. Ties resolve by 18bp top-10%-removed return, lower 18bp drawdown, lower 300ms double-trigger fraction and candidate_id.
freeze_and_selection.selection_open_rule: Download the 2025 selection files only after the frozen representatives and development result hashes are written.
freeze_and_selection.selection_gate: The same candidate must have positive 18/24bp growth, positive 18bp top-10%-removed return, at least 100 trades, both selection days positive at 18bp, PF at least 1.1 and 300ms double-trigger fraction at most 0.15.
freeze_and_selection.2026_rule: No 2026 file may be downloaded or opened by this claim. A selection survivor requires a new deep-validation claim and independent source reconstruction.

hard_invalidations: exchange timestamp used in place of local availability time
features include events at or after the decision timestamp
fit label or development path crosses a sample-day boundary
the opposite entry is canceled before the modeled cancel-effective time
signal or trade selection changed after development outcomes
selection files opened without a frozen development survivor
